name: hud_ui_main_menu_dialog_can_save_game
description: HudUiMainMenuDialog::CanSaveGame denies saving when no game state is active, allows saving for a missing or unblocked player state, and denies saving while the player save/load block flag is set.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD main-menu source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x414b90 validates reading g_GameStateOrMapTable, returning null/0 for no game state, accepting null player state, checking playerState+0x25c, returning 0 when that block flag is nonzero, and returning 1 otherwise.
The native smoke verifies the null game-state, null player-state, unblocked player-state, and blocked player-state cases.
